mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS user_id, f.id AS family_id, m.id AS merchant_id, fur.family_role FROM users u LEFT JOIN family_user_relations fur ON fur.user_id=u.id AND fur.status='ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN families f ON f.id=fur.family_id AND f.status='active' LEFT JOIN merchant_user_relations mur ON mur.user_id=u.id AND mur.status='ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN merchants m ON m.id=mur.merchant_id AND m.status='active' WHERE u.id=#{userId} AND u.status IN ('ACTIVE','CANCELLING') ORDER BY mur.id LIMIT 1
SELECT role_code FROM user_role_relations WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND status='ACTIVE'
SELECT merchant_role FROM merchant_user_relations WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND status='ACTIVE'
